notes: A one-page invoice whose line items are an aligned grid with a single rule under the headings and no cell borders. This is the shape that came back as 23 flat labels on 2026-09-03 whenever the request did not say the word table (gemini.md, A cheat sheet is not an instruction); the prompt here is deliberately empty so the recognition rule is what is being measured. Margins are drawn at 0.75in so the margin lift has something to declare.
printNotes: Added 2026-11-11 (the full audit, CC-02, CC-03, CC-09): data.json holds the page's eight lines, as the Claude Code reference printed them through DevExpress, and print checks what the report prints with them. The body is 14px at 150dpi, 6.72pt, so the font size is checked against that rather than 8 to 12, which failed the faithful size and passed +34%. The margins must be whole numbers, which DevExpress keeps.
